text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
observed: 17.0 to 17.4 s the creek shot ends with the roof-deep car drifting left until it is partly outside the left edge, a wake and floating pieces behind it, and a jagged pale vertical line descending from the wake into the water. The pale tan band along the far bank stays straight and horizontal across the full width. At 17.6 s a cut to a flooded residential street: beige houses, a live oak, a green street sign, a white sensor-roof car standing in brown water with a reflection, a dark grey rounded shape at the right edge, and a pale tiled sidewalk filling the lower third. Disclosure reads Illustration. Another car, earlier in April. No caption 17.4 to 17.8 s.
